metadata.change_reason: Tech Stack Decision and ADR quality standard: Locked PRD constraints, alternative evaluations, and zero placeholders

spec.name: Technology Stack Decision & ADR Quality Standard

rules.statement: All tech_stack items explicitly declared in the PRD frontmatter must be incorporated into locked_stack_items; overturning or unauthorized substitution is strictly prohibited
Every undecided technology selection must evaluate at least two alternative options with quantitative scoring and decision rationale
Deliverables must not contain any pending placeholders such as TBD, To Be Determined, Pending Confirmation, or None
